Its AddField gives the jsonb NOT NULL column a database default of {} (db_default), the same default 0046_org_config_db_defaults sets, so an INSERT from a pod on the previous model during a rolling upgrade (from 1.58.0) or a code rollback stores {} instead of failing NOT NULL in the window before 0046. A database that already applied it is unchanged (0046 gave it the default), and the migration state is the same after 0046; an UPDATE_SAFETY declaration is added.

Builds each of its five indexes so an interrupted run resumes, as the released 0029_request_log_unique_request_id does: an INVALID index an earlier run left is dropped first, then CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS keeps a finished one and builds the rest. Django's state is unchanged: the same five AddIndex operations, written out as literals in SeparateDatabaseAndState. A database that already applied it is unchanged. Its UPDATE_SAFETY declaration states the risk classes, the table, the concurrent builds and their lock; it changes no operation.
